title: Selective Forgetting & Counterexample Memory Compression
hypothesis: Memory selected for decision relevance and counterexamples retains at least 95% of full-history task performance using no more than 20% of retrieved tokens, outperforming equal-budget recency selection by at least 10 percentage points.
falsification_criteria: Task performance retention drops below 95% or comparative advantage over recency is below 10pp.
